crossrefs.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.
See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.
Put an end to the evil of the wicked, but establish the righteous, O righteous God who searches hearts and minds.
The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.
The LORD judges the peoples; vindicate me, O LORD, according to my righteousness and integrity.
You have tried my heart; You have visited me in the night. You have tested me and found no evil; I have resolved not to sin with my mouth.
The righteous man walks with integrity; blessed are his children after him.
But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers.
I never sat with the band of revelers, nor did I celebrate with them. Because Your hand was on me, I sat alone, for You have filled me with indignation.
I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but in the LORD I trust.
I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart; I will recount all Your wonders.
Surely in vain I have kept my heart pure; in innocence I have washed my hands.
I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.
Every morning I will remove all the wicked of the land, that I may cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.
Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.
Teach me Your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path, because of my oppressors.
He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.
Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds those who see and twists the words of the righteous.
Do not deny justice or show partiality. Do not accept a bribe, for a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise and twists the words of the righteous.
He guards the steps of His faithful ones, but the wicked perish in darkness; for by his own strength shall no man prevail.
But his sons did not walk in his ways; they turned aside toward dishonest gain, accepting bribes and perverting justice.

Now here is the king walking before you, and I am old and gray, and my sons are here with you. I have walked before you from my youth until this day. Here I am. Bear witness against me before the LORD and before His anointed: Whose ox or donkey have I taken? Whom have I cheated or oppressed? From whose hand have I accepted a bribe and closed my eyes? Tell me, and I will restore it to you.” “You have not cheated us or oppressed us,” they replied, “nor have you taken anything from the hand of man.” Samuel said to them, “The LORD is a witness against you, and His anointed is a witness today, that you have not found anything in my hand.” “He is a witness,” they replied.
